# PanGloss fixture: late-structural-anchor-five-rule-chain

## Purpose

This generic synthetic fixture is derived from the shape of a private Mbugwe failure, without copying language data. Four ordinary prefixes precede a discontinuous fifth rule in an unordered stratum. `fedcbag` is load-bearing: it requires the full five-rule chain and the late structural anchor; bare `a` is the negative control.

## Oracle and evidence

The oracle is PanGloss `pg_parse::Morpher`, not the founding C# implementation. The full engine generates `fedcbag`; the Foma proposal must contain it without truncating the finite closure.

## Ownership

This fixture tests PanGloss compiler completeness. It is permanently internal and must never be promoted to Machine.
